description: Header file defining the WebSockHttpFlexServer class, which implements a combined WebSocket and HTTP server supporting plain and SSL connections, based on Boost.Beast library. It includes class declarations, private members, and method signatures related to server initialization, certificate loading, request handling, and connection management.

classes.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer
classes.description: A server class that manages WebSocket and HTTP connections, supporting SSL and plain connections, with methods for initialization, starting, and handling requests.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server with a logger utility.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the server with host, port, certificate path, and security mode.

methods.name: AddListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for server events.

methods.name: SendToConnection
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific connection identified by connID.
